items.content_html:
Speaker Mike Johnson downplayed the use of A.I.-generated videos by President Trump that mocked Senator Chuck Schumer and Representative Hakeem Jeffries, Democratic leaders in both chambers. Johnson said his colleagues were “overreacting to a joke“

If I made such a “joke” at my job I’d likely face disciplinary action. If I did it a second time I’d be fired. Rightly so.
